parsed.rationale: I don't agree that this ECG is normal: the QRS is wide (about 140 ms or more), with broad notched monophasic R waves in I, aVL, V5 and V6, deep QS/rS complexes in V1-V3, and ST-T changes opposite to the QRS, which is left bundle branch block; the ST elevation in V1-V3 is the expected discordant change, in proportion to the deep S waves, and does not meet STEMI or Sgarbossa criteria.
